changes.text: 胜仗之后，鲁国有人在鲁君面前这样描述他：为人猜忍；年轻时家累千金，外出求官不成，散尽家财，被乡党笑话，他杀掉三十多个讥讽自己的人，从卫国郭门向东出走；与母亲诀别时啮臂立誓，不做卿相不回卫国；后来母亲去世，他始终没有回去，曾子因此与他断绝关系。进言者还算了另一笔账：鲁国是小国，有了战胜之名，诸侯就要图谋鲁国；鲁卫是兄弟之国，用吴起等于抛弃卫国。鲁君听后起疑，辞退了吴起。

After the victory, someone in Lu described him to the ruler of Lu like this: a suspicious, ruthless man. In his youth his family was worth a fortune; he went off seeking office, failed, and ran through the family fortune, until his neighbors laughed at him. He then killed more than thirty of those who had mocked him and went out eastward through the outer gate of Wey's city wall. Parting from his mother, he bit his arm and swore he would not return to Wey until he became a high minister or chancellor. She died, and he never went back, whereupon Zengzi broke with him. The speech then turned to the arithmetic: Lu is a small state, and once it carries the name of a victory, the other lords will begin to plot against Lu. Lu and Wey are brother states; to employ Wu Qi is to abandon Wey. The ruler of Lu, now suspicious, dismissed Wu Qi.
把这段进言拆开看，它没有否定吴起会打仗——否定的是他的“人”和用他的“账”：私德有亏，母死不归；小国担不起战胜之名。作者推断，这套说法的着力点，是把“他能不能打”换成了“我们要不起他”。（作者解释）被辞退后，吴起听说魏文侯贤明，想去事奉他；原文没有写他的心理，本文也不补写。

Notice what the speech never says: it does not deny that Wu Qi can fight. It attacks the man and the ledger of using him — a flaw in private character, no return home at his mother's death, a small state that cannot afford a reputation for victory. The author infers that the thrust of the speech is to swap one question for another: not can he win, but can we afford him. (The author's interpretation.) Once dismissed, he heard that Marquis Wen of Wei was worthy and sought to serve him; the source gives no inner reaction, and this article will not supply one.
吴起在楚的改革与身死，原文叙述简略：能确认的是明法审令、裁去不急之官、废公族疏远者，以及南平百越、北并陈蔡、却三晋、西伐秦这些记述；还有悼王死后宗室大臣作乱攻打吴起，吴起伏在王尸上，射刺他的人也射中了王尸，事后因此被灭宗的有七十余家。此外的细节本文不再补写。上文与下文中标注为作者推断、作者提出的替代选择，均属解释与反事实，用于讨论，不构成史实。

The account of Wu Qi's reforms in Chu and of his death is brief. What can be confirmed is the clarifying of laws and the careful framing of orders, the cutting of unneeded offices, the removal of distant members of the royal clan, and the campaigns — south against the Hundred Yue, north absorbing Chen and Cai, repelling the Three Jin, west against Qin. Also on record: after King Dao died, men of the royal house and the great ministers rose and attacked Wu Qi; he lay over the king's body; those shooting at him struck the royal corpse as well; and afterward more than seventy clans were destroyed for it. Beyond these the article adds nothing. Wherever the text above or below marks a view as an authorial inference or an author's alternative, it is interpretation and counterfactual, offered for discussion, not history.

dispositions.rationale: 删去“原文止于这段进言、未载鲁君如何处置”的错误说法，改为据E26记述鲁君起疑并辞退吴起；中英同步修改，并在ev中补入E26。
删去“原文没有写吴起对这次被疑的反应”的错误说法，改为据E26记述吴起被辞退后听说魏文侯贤明、想去事奉他，并保留不补写心理的说明。这样也补上了从鲁到魏的转折。中英同步修改，ev补入E26。

evidence.quote: 吳起於是聞魏文侯賢，欲事之。

dispositions.rationale: 边界说明原来只列出改革与征伐，现补列正文已据证据叙述的内容：宗室大臣作乱攻起、伏王尸、射者并中王尸、夷宗七十余家，使边界说明与story.7一致。中英同步修改，ev补入E23、E24。

evidence.quote: 坐射起而夷宗死者七十餘家

dispositions.rationale: 已据补入的E26通查全文。context.1中“未载鲁君处置”和context.2中“未载吴起反应”两处与E26冲突，已随F1、F2修正，并补上了鲁到魏的衔接。其余叙事、结局与因果未见与E26冲突。

evidence.quote: 魯君疑之，謝吳起。吳起於是聞魏文侯賢，欲事之。
